summary: MBX Biosciences filed a Form 8-K on August 6, 2026, reporting Q2 2026 financial results (Item 2.02), updating its corporate presentation (Item 7.01), and providing a clinical trial update (Item 8.01) for MBX 4291, stating it remains on track to report Part C data in Q4 2026. The filing is routine operational disclosure with no special-situation transaction. No deal terms, board actions, or structural changes are mentioned. What to watch: upcoming Phase 1 trial data, but no risk-arb angle.
